
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19737143" title="发布于 2026-03-19 09:29">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SourceGenerator之partial范式及测试</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        SourceGenerator往往和partial配合使用能实现更好效果
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一什么是partial范式">一、什么是partial范式</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>partial关键字允许将一个类或方法分散到多个文件中</li>
<li>所以partial是代码生成的一个很好的抓手</li>
<li>再配合Attribute特性,可以更准确定位需要生成代码的类或方法</li>
<li>可以理解为静态的“依赖注入”</li>
<li>对代码按规则自动补足,减少重复代码编写及其可能导致的失误</li>
<li>还可以代替反射提高性能,AOT友好</li>
<li>笔者称之为SourceGenerator的partial范式</li>
<li>开源项目GenerateCore用于践行partial范式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="二framework中有大量partial范式的应用">二、Framework中有大量partial范式的应用</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>正则、序列化、日志等SourceGenerator都是和partial配合使用的</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-正则表达式的case">1. 正则表达式的Case</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class Program
{

    [GeneratedRegex("abc|def", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex AbcOrDefGeneratedRegex();
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-正则表达式的生成结果">2. 正则表达式的生成结果</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class Program
{
    /// &lt;remarks&gt;
    /// Pattern:&lt;br/&gt;
    /// &lt;code&gt;abc|def&lt;/code&gt;&lt;br/&gt;
    /// Options:&lt;br/&gt;
    /// &lt;code&gt;RegexOptions.IgnoreCase&lt;/code&gt;&lt;br/&gt;
    /// Explanation:&lt;br/&gt;
    /// &lt;code&gt;
    /// ○ Match with 2 alternative expressions, atomically.&lt;br/&gt;
    ///     ○ Match a sequence of expressions.&lt;br/&gt;
    ///         ○ Match a character in the set [Aa].&lt;br/&gt;
    ///         ○ Match a character in the set [Bb].&lt;br/&gt;
    ///         ○ Match a character in the set [Cc].&lt;br/&gt;
    ///     ○ Match a sequence of expressions.&lt;br/&gt;
    ///         ○ Match a character in the set [Dd].&lt;br/&gt;
    ///         ○ Match a character in the set [Ee].&lt;br/&gt;
    ///         ○ Match a character in the set [Ff].&lt;br/&gt;
    /// &lt;/code&gt;
    /// &lt;/remarks&gt;
    [global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCodeAttribute("System.Text.RegularExpressions.Generator", "8.0.14.7010")]
    private static partial global::System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex AbcOrDefGeneratedRegex()
        =&gt; global::System.Text.RegularExpressions.Generated.AbcOrDefGeneratedRegex_0.Instance;
    // ...
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三partial范式的要素">三、partial范式的要素</h2>
<h3 id="1-attribute">1. Attribute</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Attribute特性来标记需要代码补足的位置</li>
<li>Attribute的命名最好与调用的SourceGenerator一致</li>
<li>需要生成的类有相应的Attribute也可以增加可读性(有预期该类包含自动生成的代码)</li>
<li>还可以通过Attribute给SourceGenerator传参数,SourceGenerator按参数调整生成代码</li>
<li>partial范式通过官方方法SyntaxValueProvider.ForAttributeWithMetadataName来标记定位</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-filter">2. Filter</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ISyntaxFilter是节点过滤接口</li>
<li>SyntaxFilter是默认实现,实现按节点类型和是否为partial来过滤</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">interface ISyntaxFilter
{
    bool Match(SyntaxNode node, CancellationToken cancellation);
}
class SyntaxFilter(bool isPartial, params SyntaxKind[] kinds)
    : ISyntaxFilter;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-generatorsource">3. GeneratorSource</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>GeneratorSource是转化源,是Transform的预处理结果</li>
<li>IGeneratorSource是转化源接口</li>
<li>GenerateFileName是生成文件名属性</li>
<li>Generate是生成代码方法</li>
<li>SyntaxGenerator是通过SyntaxTree生成代码的辅助类,是EasySyntax项目的功能</li>
<li><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19688804" target="_blank">查看介绍EasySyntax的文章</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">interface IGeneratorSource
{
    string GenerateFileName { get; }
    SyntaxGenerator Generate();
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-transform">4. Transform</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Transform是对节点预处理</li>
<li>把GeneratorAttributeSyntaxContext转化为需要的GeneratorSource类型</li>
<li>GeneratorAttributeSyntaxContext包含成员节点、节点符号、节点特性列表和SemanticModel</li>
<li>如果不满足生成必要条件返回null会被自动过滤</li>
<li>ISyntaxTransform是转化接口</li>
<li>PassTransform是默认实现,直接返回官方对象</li>
<li>TSource一般实现接口IGeneratorSource</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">interface IGeneratorTransform&lt;TSource&gt;
{
    TSource? Transform(GeneratorAttributeSyntaxContext context, CancellationToken cancellation);
}
class PassTransform : IGeneratorTransform&lt;GeneratorAttributeSyntaxContext&gt;
{
    public GeneratorAttributeSyntaxContext Transform(GeneratorAttributeSyntaxContext context, CancellationToken cancellation)
        =&gt; context;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-executor">5. Executor</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>IGeneratorExecutor是执行器接口</li>
<li>GeneratorExecutor是默认实现,一般可以直接使用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">interface IGeneratorExecutor&lt;TSource&gt;
{
    void Execute(SourceProductionContext context, TSource source);
}
class GeneratorExecutor&lt;TSource&gt; : IGeneratorExecutor&lt;TSource&gt;
    where TSource : IGeneratorSource
{
    public virtual void Execute(SourceProductionContext context, TSource source)
    {
        var cancellation = context.CancellationToken;
        if (cancellation.IsCancellationRequested)
            return;
        var builder = source.Generate();
        var code = builder.Build()
            .WithGenerated()
            .ToFullString();
        context.AddSource(source.GenerateFileName, code);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="6-生成器基类valuesgenerator">6. 生成器基类ValuesGenerator</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过ValuesGenerator简化代码生成器开发</li>
<li>把业务逻辑都提取到TSource中</li>
<li>filter、transform和executor都会很简单</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class ValuesGenerator&lt;TSource&gt;(
    string attributeName, 
    ISyntaxFilter filter, 
    ISyntaxTransform&lt;TSource&gt; transform, 
    ISyntaxExecutor&lt;TSource&gt; executor);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="四通过valuesgenerator实现代码生成器的case">四、通过ValuesGenerator实现代码生成器的Case</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>定义类型HelloGenerator继承ValuesGenerator</li>
<li>另外需要实现HelloGeneratorAttribute、HelloTransform和HelloSource</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-hellogenerator代码非常简单">1. HelloGenerator代码非常简单</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>含义是查找HelloGenerator标记</li>
<li>查找含partial修饰的类</li>
<li>使用HelloTransform转化HelloSource</li>
<li>执行HelloSource生成代码</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class HelloGenerator()
    : ValuesGenerator&lt;HelloSource&gt;(
    "GenerateCoreTests.Hello.HelloGeneratorAttribute",
    new SyntaxFilter(true, SyntaxKind.ClassDeclaration),
    new HelloTransform(),
    new GeneratorExecutor&lt;HelloSource&gt;())
{
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-hellogeneratorattribute非常简单">2. HelloGeneratorAttribute非常简单</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = false)]
class HelloGeneratorAttribute : Attribute
{
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-hellotransform非常简单">3. HelloTransform非常简单</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class HelloTransform : IGeneratorTransform&lt;HelloSource&gt;
{
    public HelloSource? Transform(GeneratorAttributeSyntaxContext context, CancellationToken cancellation)
    {
        if (context.TargetNode is ClassDeclarationSyntax type &amp;&amp; context.TargetSymbol is INamedTypeSymbol symbol)
            return new(type, symbol);
        return null;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-hellosource是比较纯净的业务逻辑">4. HelloSource是比较纯净的业务逻辑</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class HelloSource(ClassDeclarationSyntax type, INamedTypeSymbol symbol)
    : IGeneratorSource
{
    private readonly ClassDeclarationSyntax _type = type;
    private readonly INamedTypeSymbol _symbol = symbol;
    string GenerateFileName
        =&gt; $"{_symbol.ToDisplayString()}.Hello.g.cs";
    public SyntaxGenerator Generate()
    {
        var builder = SyntaxGenerator.Clone(_type);
        var method = GenerateMethod();
        builder.AddMember(method);
        return builder;
    }
    public static MethodDeclarationSyntax GenerateMethod()
    {
        var name = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("name");
        var expression = SyntaxGenerator.Interpolation()
            .Add("Hello: '")
            .Add(name)
            .Add("'")
            .Build();

        return SyntaxGenerator.VoidType.Method("SayHello", SyntaxGenerator.StringType.Parameter(name.Identifier))
            .Public()
            .Static()
            .ToBuilder()
            .Add(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Console").Access("WriteLine").Invocation([expression]))
            .End();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-测试代码如下">5. 测试代码如下</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">namespace GenerateCoreTests.Hello;

[HelloGenerator]
public partial class HelloTests;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="6-生成代码如下">6. 生成代码如下</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// &lt;auto-generated/&gt;
namespace GenerateCoreTests.Hello;
partial class HelloTests
{
    public static void SayHello(string name)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Hello: '{name}'");
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五generatecore更多功能">五、GenerateCore更多功能</h2>
<h3 id="1-分析编译符号">1. 分析编译符号</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>有时需要分析现有代码才能更好的生成代码</li>
<li>用SymbolTypeDescriptor和SymbolTypeBuilder分析代码</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="11-提取符号">1.1 提取符号</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>可以提取其中一种或多种符号</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SymbolTypeDescriptor GetDescriptor(Compilation compilation, INamedTypeSymbol symbol)
{
    // 提取字段、属性、构造函数、方法和运算符重载等信息
    var builder = new SymbolTypeBuilder()
        .WithField()
        .WithProperty()
        .WithConstructor()
        .WithOperator()
        .WithMethod();
    return builder.Build(compilation, symbol);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-获取符号">1.2 获取符号</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过SymbolTypeDescriptor获取符号</li>
<li>这样可以判断某个成员是否存在,用于生成排重或是否可以调用</li>
<li>只有先配置了提取的符号类型才能获取到</li>
<li>以下获取符号比直接分析成员简单且可读性好</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取字段
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IFieldSymbol? GetField(string name);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取属性
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IPropertySymbol? GetProperty(string name);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取构造函数
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetConstructor(params INamedTypeSymbol[] parameterTypes)
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取方法
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetMethod(string name, bool isPartial, params INamedTypeSymbol[] parameterTypes);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取方法
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetMethod(string name, params INamedTypeSymbol[] parameterTypes);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 按返回类型获取方法
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IEnumerable&lt;IMethodSymbol&gt; GetMethodsByReturnType(INamedTypeSymbol returnType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取运算符重载
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetOperator(string name, params INamedTypeSymbol[] parameterTypes);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取相等重载符
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetEqualOperator(INamedTypeSymbol otherType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取不等重载符
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetUnEqualOperator(INamedTypeSymbol otherType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取相加重载符
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetAddOperator(INamedTypeSymbol otherType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取相减重载符
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetSubtractOperator(INamedTypeSymbol otherType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取相乘重载符
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetMultiplyOperator(INamedTypeSymbol otherType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取相除重载符
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetDivideOperator(INamedTypeSymbol otherType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取求余重载符
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetModOperator(INamedTypeSymbol otherType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取逻辑与重载符
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetAndOperator(INamedTypeSymbol otherType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取逻辑或重载符
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IMethodSymbol? GetOrOperator(INamedTypeSymbol otherType);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-symbolattributehelper解析attribute">2. SymbolAttributeHelper解析Attribute</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取标记
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IEnumerable&lt;AttributeData&gt; GetAttributesByType(IEnumerable&lt;AttributeData&gt; attributes, INamedTypeSymbol attributeType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取标记
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
IEnumerable&lt;AttributeData&gt; GetAttributesByType(ISymbol symbol, INamedTypeSymbol attributeType);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取标记参数值
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
TValue? GetArgumentValue&lt;TValue&gt;(ISymbol symbol, INamedTypeSymbol? attributeType, string name);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取标记参数值
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
TValue? GetArgumentValue&lt;TValue&gt;(ISymbol symbol, INamedTypeSymbol? attributeType, int index);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取标记参数值
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
TValue? GetArgumentValue&lt;TValue&gt;(AttributeData attribute, string name);
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 获取标记参数值
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
TValue? GetArgumentValue&lt;TValue&gt;(AttributeData attribute, int index);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="六sourcegenerator测试">六、SourceGenerator测试</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SourceGenerator的测试是有点麻烦</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-debuggerlaunch用于测试">1. Debugger.Launch用于测试</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>在需要测试的代码前增加Debugger.Launch()</li>
<li>vs生成代码会触发断点</li>
<li>缺点是不能单元测试且多线程执行影响调试体验还容易导致vs奔溃</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-microsoftcodeanalysisanalyzertesting用于测试">2. Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Analyzer.Testing用于测试</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>优点是官方支持、支持单元测试</li>
<li>感兴趣的可以体验一下,笔者有点用不习惯</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="3-开源项目syntaxscripting测试sourcegenerator">3. 开源项目SyntaxScripting测试SourceGenerator</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>SyntaxScripting非常简单,只有1个类SyntaxTreeScript</li>
<li>用于解析、编译代码和执行SourceGenerator</li>
<li>执行SourceGenerator是通过官方的GeneratorDriver实现的</li>
<li>是本次重点推荐的组件</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31-syntaxscripting执行sourcegenerator的case">3.1 SyntaxScripting执行SourceGenerator的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Generate返回GeneratorDriver,再通过GetRunResult可以获取生成结果</li>
<li>GeneratedTrees为本次生成的表达式树,如果为空表示没有生成成功</li>
<li>Diagnostics返回编译信息,一般为出错信息</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = "partial class Greeting;";
var service = SyntaxTreeScript.Create()
    .Using("System");
var result = service.Generate&lt;HelloGenerator&gt;(source)
    .GetRunResult();
var tree = result.GeneratedTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(tree);
var diagnostics = result.Diagnostics;
Assert.Empty(diagnostics);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-syntaxscripting添加引用">3.2 SyntaxScripting添加引用</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Reference增加该类的程序集为引用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var service = SyntaxTreeScript.Create()
    .Reference&lt;DateTime&gt;();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="33-default">3.3 Default</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Default是默认实例,静态共享</li>
<li>默认using System</li>
<li>默认引用CurrentDomain的所有程序集</li>
<li>易错点是当前引用通过AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies()不一定能获取到</li>
<li>如果没有类被调用程序集可能就不会被加载</li>
<li>也就是说即使用Default也可能需要添加引用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = "partial class Greeting;";
var result = SyntaxScripting.Default.Generate&lt;HelloGenerator&gt;(source)
    .GetRunResult();
var tree = result.GeneratedTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(tree);
var diagnostics = result.Diagnostics;
Assert.Empty(diagnostics);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="34-createdefault">3.4 CreateDefault</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>同Default一样using System并引用CurrentDomain的所有程序集</li>
<li>不同之处是非共享,每次调用CreateDefault都是新实例</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = "partial class Greeting;";
var result = SyntaxScripting.CreateDefault()
    .Generate&lt;HelloGenerator&gt;(source)
    .GetRunResult();
var tree = result.GeneratedTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(tree);
var diagnostics = result.Diagnostics;
Assert.Empty(diagnostics);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="35-new可以配置更多参数">3.5 new可以配置更多参数</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">SyntaxTreeScript(
    CSharpParseOptions options, 
    string path, 
    List&lt;UsingDirectiveSyntax&gt; usings, 
    List&lt;MetadataReference&gt; references);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-直接测试转化源对象">4. 直接测试转化源对象</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>其他的逻辑都可以理解为配置</li>
<li>转化源对象是真正的业务逻辑</li>
<li>是更适合单元测试的对象</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="41-测试代码如下">4.1 测试代码如下</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>代码虽然看着多,其实很简单</li>
<li>而且绕过了SourceGenerator机制,直接执行业务逻辑</li>
<li>这里还是用了SyntaxScripting组件,用来简化测试代码</li>
<li>首先编译源代码code0</li>
<li>其次从编译信息从提取type和symbol</li>
<li>执行HelloSource</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var code0 = @"
namespace GenerateCoreTests.Hello;

[HelloGenerator]
partial class HelloTests;
";
var compilation = SyntaxTreeScript.Default
    .Compile(code0);
var syntaxTree = compilation.SyntaxTrees.FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(syntaxTree);
var type = syntaxTree.GetRoot()
    .DescendantNodes()
    .OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;()
    .FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(type);
var semanticModel = compilation.GetSemanticModel(syntaxTree);
var symbol = semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(type);
Assert.NotNull(symbol);
HelloSource source = new(type, symbol);
var builder = source.Generate();
var code = builder.Build()
    .WithGenerated()
    .ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("SayHello", code);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="七总结">七、总结</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>partial范式(GenerateCore+EasySyntax)简化SourceGenerator开发</li>
<li>partial范式支持把业务(GeneratorSource)独立拆分,增加代码可读性和可测试性</li>
<li>SyntaxScripting(+EasySyntax)支持对SourceGenerator执行和测试</li>
<li>SyntaxScripting也能支持对GeneratorSource直接执行测试</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>源码托管地址: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/Hand.Generators" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/Hand.Generators</a> ，欢迎大家直接查看源码。<br>
